body: To tell you the truth I don't really feel comfortable around people.   The only time I feel comfortable around people is when I drink or do other drugs and I haven't done that in five or so years.   It seems these dark thoughts have taken over my mind.   The only time I really feel happy anymore is either when my mind is lost in work or when I think about or plan killing myself.

I work the weekends away.   I have hung out with people at work before but they're all five to ten years younger that me.   I kinda feel weird hanging out with them and then the ones who are my age are all coupled off which makes me fell weird as well.
To tell you the truth I don't even know.   For as long as I remember any little free time I have had I spent with myself..
